newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Meyer-inflation stable while jobless low.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Meyer-inflation stable while jobless low.

text.p: Federal Reserve governor Laurence Meyer said Friday it was a serious question whether there had been structural change in the economy and whether the so-called natural rate of unemployment had declined.

"We have a situation where over the last two years inflation has been remarkably stable at the same time that the unemployment rate has been in a range of 5.3 to 5.8 (percent), now down to 5.1," Meyer told a conference convened by the American Economic Association.

"So there is a serious question whether there has been structural chancge and whether or not NAIRU (the non accelerating inflation rate of unemployment) has declined," Meyer said as the moderator of a panel discussion on the issue.
